title: Transportation of 84 Nos Battery cell with all accessories from Korlai Fort Lighthouse to Nanwel point Lighthouse.
summary: Notice inviting quotations for transporting 84 battery cells (2V/1000Ah) with accessories from Korlai Fort Lighthouse to Nanwel Point Lighthouse, Raigad District, Maharashtra, including head-load carriage from Nanwel village where there is no motorable road (Mumbai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Korlai Fort Lighthouse, Raigadh Dist., Maharashtra 402202
sites.work: Loading of 84 battery cells with accessories (origin)

sites.name: Nanwel Point Lighthouse, Post Dighi, Raigadh Dist., Maharashtra 402402
sites.work: Delivery of 84 battery cells, head-load from Nanwel village (destination)

scope.item: Transportation of batteries including all accessories (2V/1000Ah - 84 Nos) from Korlai Fort Lighthouse to Nanwel Point Lighthouse including labour for loading and unloading at both locations, truck/lorry hiring, tools, tackles, insurance, all inclusive

money.notes: Estimated cost incl. GST Rs 2,00,000. No advance payment; any transit damage/loss recovered from payment; contractor may insure at own cost; TDS on GST and IT deducted.

period.completion: 15 days from date of issue of supply order

eligibility: Valid PAN and GST number (copies with bid)
specs: 84 Nos battery cells 2V/1000Ah with all accessories
Truck/lorry from Korlai Fort Lighthouse to Nanwel village, then labour/head load to Nanwel Point Lighthouse (no motorable road)
